guide.title: How Udhaar works
guide.subtitle: Two things to remember: your pocket and your notebook
guide.intro: A khata keeps two different things apart. Your pocket holds the real money you have. Your notebook only writes down who owes whom.
guide.ruleSign: On every row, + (green) means money came into your pocket and - means it went out.
guide.ruleCards: The Net, Get and Give cards and the Gave / Got tabs follow your notebook.
guide.ruleForgive: Forgiven (maaf) is the only time no money moves. Only the notebook changes.

guide.title: Backup & Restore
guide.subtitle: Keep your khata safe and move it to a new phone
guide.intro: A backup is a small copy of your khata in one file, like a photo of your notebook.
guide.step1: Tap Back up and send the file somewhere safe: Google Drive, Files, or WhatsApp to yourself.
guide.step2: Open this screen on the new phone and tap Restore. Pick the file you saved.
guide.step3: Restore only adds what is missing. It never deletes or replaces what you already have, so restoring twice is safe.
guide.step4: The same file works in the web dashboard. A phone backup carries your Udhaar and parties.
guide.note: Demo data is only for practice, so it is never backed up.
